children: OpenAI said Wednesday it is pushing for mandatory national AI safety requirements, adding that until the U.S. Congress acts, the ChatGPT maker will continue supporting state AI legislation.

"Today, we are announcing our support for four California bills: SB 813 on overall infrastructure for independent safety assessments, AB 1405 on AI-auditor standards, SB 1119 on protections for young people, and AB 1864 on safeguards against AI-enabled biological threats", OpenAI said in a blog post.
